text.p: Tropical Storm Levi is in the western Pacific, near 24.4n/127.5e, moving north northeast at 12 mph. Top winds are 50 mph but should slowly weaken during the next 48 hours. Levi is expected to pass southeast of Okinawa and out to sea. This system will threaten shipping.

Tropical Storm Marie (06W), with 45 mph winds, is in the western Pacific near 14.2n/158.3e, moving north at 5 mph. This system will maintain intensity over the next 24-36 hours before weakening and dissipating.

Tropical Cyclone 37P, with 35 mph winds, is in the southern Pacific near 15.9s/167.7e, moving south-southeast at 8 mph. This system will begin to weaken and lose tropical characteristics by 24-36 hours. It is only a threat to shipping and should pass east of the island of Espiritu Santu.
